evals.prompt: I just incorporated my startup through Stripe Atlas and I'm on H-1B with my current employer who laid me off two weeks ago. I want my own company to sponsor me. I have the Delaware certificate, EIN letter, my two I-797 approval notices and my passport in a folder. Where do I start and what else do I need?
evals.expected_output: Starts intake per the skill: explains the LCA is the gate, lists the missing documents from evidence-map, begins building case.json, notes the 60-day grace period and portability, asks the Phase 1 questions it cannot answer from the files.

evals.prompt: Here is my certified LCA, my support letter draft, offer letter and job description. Check whether they contradict each other before I fill the I-129.
evals.expected_output: Runs the consistency checklist and reports a table of mismatches (dates, wage, hours split, degree wording, titles, exhibits) with fixes; does not rewrite frozen documents.

evals.prompt: I'm logged into my company's USCIS account in Chrome. Fill in the I-129 for me from case.json and upload the PDFs in ~/Documents/H1B, but don't submit — I'll pay myself.
evals.expected_output: Loads Chrome tools in one call, opens a new tab, works section by section with saves, uploads evidence under the right categories, reviews the draft PDF against case.json, continues to I-907, and stops at 'Ready to pay and submit' with a screenshot and the fee amount.
